articles.summary: ARLINGTON, Va., Nov. 09, 2026 — AeroVironment, Inc. (“AV”) (NASDAQ: AVAV) today announced a multiyear indefinite-delivery, indefinite-quantity (IDIQ) contract with a ceiling of $940 million with a U.S. customer, including an approximately $315 million initial award for product deliveries and support. The award is expected to support continued delivery of advanced capabilities through AV’s AxS segment, further […]
articles.title: AV Secures Approximately $315 Million Award Under $940 Million IDIQ Contract
